quests.title: Brook the Carnivore

dialogue.t: I guess you saw my commission, huh? Well, you're just in time.
Do you have those six servings of Fowl?
The quality of these meats is quite good...
Come on over when I'm done with my research — you'll be the first to try my new dish, I promise.

quests.description: Springvale’s Brook requires six servings of Fowl.
